articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude 4, its most capable model to date, featuring a 2 million token context window and an enhanced reasoning mode that rivals human expert performance on complex scientific benchmarks. The model introduces a new 'deep reflection' feature that allows it to pause and self-critique before delivering final answers. Claude 4 is available immediately through the API and Claude.ai subscription tiers.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaAgent Framework Automates Multi-Step Scientific Research Tasks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaAgent, an agentic AI system capable of autonomously designing and running multi-step experiments in drug discovery and materials science. In internal benchmarks, AlphaAgent completed research workflows that previously took human teams weeks in under 48 hours. The framework integrates with laboratory robotics APIs, marking a significant step toward fully autonomous scientific research.

articles.title: OpenAI Strikes $4 Billion Enterprise Deal with U.S. Department of Defense
articles.summary: OpenAI has finalized a landmark $4 billion contract with the U.S. Department of Defense to provide GPT-5 class models for logistics optimization, intelligence analysis, and cybersecurity applications. The deal, which was revealed through federal procurement records, represents the largest single AI contract in U.S. government history. Critics and safety advocates have raised concerns about the scope of autonomous decision-making permitted under the agreement.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout as Fully Open-Source Multimodal Model
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a 109-billion parameter multimodal model capable of processing text, images, video, and audio within a single unified architecture. The release includes full model weights, training code, and a detailed technical report, making it the most capable openly available multimodal model to date. Early benchmarks from the community show Scout outperforming GPT-4o on several vision-language tasks.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines Totaling €450 Million
articles.summary: The newly empowered EU AI Office issued its first significant enforcement actions under the AI Act, levying combined fines of €450 million against three unnamed companies for deploying high-risk AI systems without completing required conformity assessments. The fines signal a new era of regulatory teeth in European AI governance following the Act's full enforcement phase that began in January 2026. Industry groups have called for clearer compliance guidance while consumer advocates praised the swift action.

articles.title: Microsoft Azure Launches Real-Time RAG Pipeline with Automatic Knowledge Graph Updates
articles.summary: Microsoft Azure has introduced a new managed RAG service that automatically builds and updates knowledge graphs from enterprise document repositories in near real-time. The service, called Azure AI Knowledge Sync, uses a hybrid dense-sparse retrieval architecture that the company claims reduces hallucination rates by 63% compared to standard vector search RAG implementations. The offering is now in general availability for Azure enterprise customers.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Finds AI Coding Assistants Now Write 47% of Merged Code on GitHub
articles.summary: A new Stanford Human-Centered AI Institute report analyzing GitHub metadata reveals that AI-generated or AI-assisted code now accounts for 47% of all merged pull requests on the platform, up from 28% in mid-2025. The study also found that AI-authored code has a marginally higher bug rate in security-sensitive modules but performs comparably in general application logic. Researchers warn that growing AI code dependency may create systemic risks if underlying model providers face outages or discontinue services.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Edge 3B: A Multimodal Model Optimized for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has announced Mistral Edge 3B, a compact 3-billion parameter model designed to run entirely on consumer smartphones and laptops with support for text and image inputs. The model uses a novel quantization technique called NeuralFlux that maintains 95% of full-precision benchmark performance at 4-bit quantization. Mistral is positioning the release as a privacy-first alternative to cloud-based AI assistants, with local processing ensuring user data never leaves the device.
